full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff-respondent, Md Sekandar Ali filed the suit for declaration of his title to the suit land comprising of 1.91 acre of land including a part of a tank and a homestead and also for confirmation of possession therein stating, inter alia, that on 10th Baisakh 1353 BS he took patta of the suit land at a salami of Rs 99.00 from one Nogendra Lal Kandu, the predecessor of the defendants and got possession therein; that during SA operation the said property has wrongly been recorded in the name of the defendants and that the plaintiff having come to know of such wrong recording in the SA record in Ashwin 1384 BS instituted the suit.
